title: Campaign: ReadyNeuro, patterns along the person
abstract: Subcampaign of 'what new facts about human brain activity can ReadyNeuro reveal?'. Scope: Differences between people. How it splits: Is the person variable a recorded label (age, sex, from the manifests) or measured from the person's own images (anatomy from the T1 and segmentation in each shard)? It holds 2 leaf studies with first tests (age-dynamics, anatomy-function). No results yet.
